item.title: Artificial Intelligence and Operations: A Foundational Framework of Emerging Research and Practice
item.description:
Dai, T., Swaminathan, J.
Artificial intelligence (AI) is poised to reshape operations across industries. Yet its real-world impact reveals a jagged and uneven implementation frontier. To make sense of this emerging landscape, we develop a foundational framework that synthesizes research and practice at the intersection of AI and Operations Management (OM), anchored in three interdependent pillars: (1) AI for OM, (2) OM for AI, and (3) Human–AI Interaction. item.description:
Kenji Logie

item.description:
